$comment: Manifest of the SimPay Mobile SDK functional contract. Platform independent: read by the iOS (Swift Testing) and Android (JUnit) conformance runners and by the future Flutter and React Native adapters. See Contract/README.md for the versioning rules.
name: simpay-mobile-contract
testData: All tokens, e-mail addresses and IP addresses are synthetic: tokens use the mobsdk_test_ prefix, e-mails the example.com domain (RFC 2606) and IPs the TEST-NET ranges (RFC 5737).
